tei:div.tei:p: 851)༄༅/ bla ma gsang 'dus gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi zab gter las byon pa'i tshes bcu'i gar 'cham rtsa tho sna tshogs nor bu'i drwa mig bzhugs/ 852)༄༅/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi rigs kyi khyab bdag slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ dpal ldan tshogs gnyis sa bon grung po dang por btab las 'di na rgyal ba'i myu gu ni// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i phung po gcig tu bkod pa'i ngo mtshar 'dab phreng bzhad pa'i dpal// 'gro ba'i snying la phan bde'i zil mngar rtag tu 'beb pa'i legs byas 'dod dgu'i gter chen po// grangs med rgyal ba'i rigs kyi khyab bdag mtsho skyes rdo rjes srid 'dir mchog bde'i bka' drin stsol/ gangs can ljongs mun mi bzad brtsegs pa'i dpung*// thugs rje'i zer phreng gtum pos bcom nas slar// yang dag snang bas gsal 853)byas thub bstan kyi// pad rtsa sbom por byas la su mi gus// de yi zhal lung ḍā ki'i thugs kyi nor// mi shigs phyag rgyas btab pa'i 'dod rgu'i gter// rang dbang gyur las phyogs 'dir yid rton pa'i// thar 'dod rnams kyi dga' ston nyid du spro/ de la 'dir gter ston chen po gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi zab gter las byon pa'i bla ma gsang 'dus kyi sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i dpal u rgyan rin po che pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi tshes bcu'i gar 'cham chen mo'i 'cham rtsa dbyangs rol drwa mig bcas kyi zin bris cung zad bri ba la/ dang po bla ma gsang 'dus sgrub zhag rdzogs pa dang ches dgu'i nyin tho rangs snga bar tshogs 854)nas tshogs drang ba'i 'go bar bton nas/ 'cham khang du rdo rwa'i steng du ser sbreng gis bskor nas rol khang du skyabs mgon khri rin po che gdan la 'khod nas g.yas g.yon khri steng bla sprul khag rnams dang*/ de mdun byang 'dren/ khri gdan g.yas g.yon du rol len pa dang*/

rnga gral g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi mthar/ dung dkar gnyis/ gang bder dung chen/ rkang gling*/ rgya gling*/ las rdor bzhi nas mchod stegs bshams bkod rnams zhib par bya ba dang*/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ rnam thar gsol 'debs/ shwa lo ka ya zung*/ cha gsum/ sngon gtor/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpa' bo rta mgrin yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ las sogs/ gang dag 'dir gnas= stsal du gsol/ dung dkar/ sarba bhu dha akar+sha ya dza dzaḥ oṃ sarba 855) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 856) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 857) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 858) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 859)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 860) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 861)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 862)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 863)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 864)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 865)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 866)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 867)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 868) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 869) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 870)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 871)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 872)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 873) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 874)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 875) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 876) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 877)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 878) (Musical notes, designs and signs here) 879)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 880)(Musical notes, designs and signs here) 881)(Musical notes,

893)༄༅/ nag rtsis sngon 'gro blta bder bkod pa bzhugs so/ rtsis 'thor bu la/ shar stod stag la/ shar smad yos/ shar lho 'brug lho stod sbrul/ lho smad rta/ lho nub lug nub stod sprel/ nub smad bya/ nub byang khyi/ byang stod phag byang smad byi ba/ byang shar glang*/ ༈ byi ba stag 'brug rta sprel khyi drug pho lo yin/ glang yos sbrul lug bya phag mo lo drug ༈ spar kha 'di ltar lho phyogs li me sbrul// lho nub sa khams spar kha khon sa lug nub phyogs lcags khams spar kha dwa lcags sprel// nub byang spar kha khen sa khyi gnam sgo// byang ni chu khams spar kha khaṃ chu phag /byang shar spar kha ging ri sa glang dang*// shar shing khams la spar kha zin shing 894)stag /shar lho spar kha zon rlung sa 'brug go ༈ sme ba gcig dkar/ gnyis nag gsum mthing*/ bzhi ljang*/ snga ser/ drug dkar/ bdun dmar/ brgyad dkar/ dgu dmar ro/ ༈ mthe bong shing la/ mdzub mo me/ gung mo sa/ srin lag lcags/ mthe'u chung chu/ ༈ shing bu me/ me bu sa/ sa bu lcags/ lcags bu chu/ chu bu shing*/ ༈ shing ma chu/ chu ma lcags/ lcags ma sa/ sa ma me/ me ma shing*/ ༈ shing grogs sa/ sa grogs chu/ chu grogs me/ me grogs lcags/ lcags grogs shing*/ ༈ shing dgra lcags/ lcags dgra me/ me dgra chu/ chu dgra sa/ sa dgra shing*/ ༈ stag yos gnyis srog shing*/ bya sprel gnyis srog lcags/ rta sbrul gnyis srog me/ byi phag gnyis srog 895)chu/ khyi 'brug glang lug bzhi srog sa/ ༈ dbang thang ni/ gnam lo pho lo shar ba'i dus// gcig bcu rang rang la gnyis gsum// bzhi lnga dgra la drug bdun grogs// brgyad dgu bu ru shes par bya/ ༈ gnam lo mo lo shar ba'i dus// gcig gnyis rang la gsum bzhi ma// lnga drug dgra la bdun brgyad grogs// dgu bcu bu ru shes par bya/ ༈ lus kyi lde'u mig bstan pa ni// glang lug rta byi zin nas brtsi/ khyi 'brug phag sbrul dwa nas brtsi// stag sprel bya yos kham nas brtsi/

g.yas skor bya sa la lcags chu me// sa shing lnga ru bsgrang bar bya// dbang thang lus gnyis bab dag bstun/ ༈ de nas rlung rta 896)bshad pa ni// stag rta khyi gsum lcags sprel gnyis nag dang*// phag lug yos gsum me sbrul lnga ser dang*// bya 'brug sprel gsum shing stag brgyad dkar dang*// bya glang sbrul gsum chu phag brgyad dkar ro/ ༈ lo yi thog mar shing pho byi ba dang*// dpyid ra stag dang dpyid 'bring yos bu dang*// dpyid tha 'brug gi zla ba dbyar ra sbrul// dbyar 'bring rta zla dbyar tha lug zla dang*// ston ra sprel zla ston 'bring bya zla dang*// ston tha khyi dang dgun ra phag zla dang*// dgun 'bring byi ba dgun tha glang zla'o/ ༈ de nas zla ba'i dbang thang ni// stag yos byi glang gnam lo'i bu// 'brug sbrul grogs la rta lug dgra// sprel bya ma la khyi phag rang*/ ༈ zhag gi dbang thang 897)ngos 'dzin ni// gcig drug zla bu gnyis bdun grogs// gsum brgyad dgra la dgu bzhi ma// lnga gsum bcu gsum rang thog 'byor/ ༈ zla ba pho drug stag gi tshes// mo drug sprel gyi nyi ma tshes gcig la'o/ ༈ dus tshod bcu gnyis nam langs yos// nyi shar 'brug la nyi dros sbrul// nyin phyed rta la phyed yol lug /dgong chen sprel la nyi thal bya// mun rub khyi la srod 'khor phag nam phyed byi ba phyed yol glang*// tho rangs stag gi dus tshod do/ ༈ dus tshod dbang thang 'di ltar bshad// yos sprel glang gsum nyi ma'i bu// 'brug bya rta gsum nyi ma'i grogs// khyi sbrul dgra la rta phag ma// lug dang byi ba rang du 'dod// 898)༈ rme ba gcig bzhi bdun dmar gsum// bya yos byi rta bzhi la dbang*// gsum drug dgu dmar gsum po ni/ khyi 'brug glang lug bzhi la dbang*// gnyis nag lnga ser brgyad dkar gsum// stag sprel phag sbrul bzhi pa'o/ ༈ yar bzhi srog la mar bzhi dbang*// gang skyes lus kyi rme ba'o// dkar gsum lcags la nag mthing chu// lnga pa bzhi shing dmar gnyis me/

༈ gcig dang bcu gsum nyer lnga so bdun dang*// zhe dgu re gcig don gsum gya lnga dang*// go bdun rnams ni rang lo 'khrul ba bral/ ༈ skyes pa li nas g.yas su bskor ba dang*// bud med kham nas g.yon par bskor ngos 'dzin/ 899)/spar kha mi yi pho mo dang*// sme ba lo yi pho mo ste// dbus nas shar thon pho lo g.yas// mo lo g.yon bskor bcu nyi shu// sum cu la sogs brtsi bar bya// 'phur sme la brtsi bya'i srog gi 'thab/ 'phur sme ma la lus/ bu la dbang*/ srog la rlung*/ dgra la rus khams/ ༈ log men gnam lo'i dbang thang gi /bu stag nas bgrang lo gar bab// skyes pa sbubs nas bsgrang bar bya/ bud med gnam lo'i dbang thang gi ma sprel nas bkan par byas la lo grangs brtsi/ ༈ de nas dar rgud bcu gnyis ni// shing dbugs sprel la me dbugs phag /sa chu dbugs 900)sbrul lcags dbugs stag /'byung khams rang rang lo de nas// dbugs rgyu mngal gnas lus rdzogs dang*// btsas pa khrus byed gos gyon dang*// las byed dar ba rgud pa dang*// na ba shi ba dur zhugs so// srog ni gnam lo la gtugs shing*// lus zla dbang zhag rnams la gtugs// rlung rta dus sam yang na lo// gtugs par byed la brtsi bar gyis// dar gud rde'u bzhag tshul ni// gos las dar gsum dkar po gnyis// lus btsas khrus gsum dkar po gcig /rgud na shi gsum nag po gnyis// dur dbugs mngal gnas nag po gcig ༈ sme ba// dbus nas gnam lcags ri bo la// me chu sa shing rlung nas dbus/ 901)/ma 'phrad dkar gnyis grogs dkar gcig /dgra 'phrad nag gnyis bu nag gcig /sa chu nag 'phrad dkar po gcig /me lcags shing 'phrad nag po gcig ༈ gza' khams nyi ma mig dmar me// zla lhag chu khams phur bu shing*// pa sangs lcags la spen pa sa// tha dkar bra nye smin drug dang*// snar ma mgo lag rgyal nabs so// skag dang rta chen ta chung dbo// me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang*// sa ga lha mtshams snon dang snubs// chu stod chu smad gro byin dang*// mon bre mon gru khrum stod smad// nam gru rgyu skar nyer brgyad de/

902)/smin sogs skar drug shar shing khams// mchu sogs drug ni lho me khams// lha mtshams sogs drug nub lcags khams// mon bre sogs drug byang chu khams// bra nye skag dang sa ga dang*// byi bzhin bzhi ni sa yi khams// lo dang zla ba sbrags ded de// dper na shing pho byi ba dang*// shing mo glang sogs bzhin tu ded// zhag dang dus tshod rkyang ded de// me stag sa yos lcags 'brug bzhin/ ༈ mthun gsum tshes te/ stag rta khyi gsum spen pas tshes// phag lug yos gsum zla bas tshes// byi 'brug sprel gsum mig dmar tshes// bya glang sbrul gsum phur bus tshes/ gang tshes de dar bu 903)yang dar// ma zhud dgra gud grogs ni gyod/ ༈ dgongs 'dus dkar mdzod lugs chags med zhabs dang 'jigs med gling pa rnams kyi zla ba bcu gnyis pa stag gi zla ba dang*/ gzhan yang sa dge bka' rnying gsum dang phug lugs rnams/ zla ba bcu gcig pa stag zlar brtsi tshul 'dra min 'gar bzhugs 'dug/ ༈ yar bkan dgos pa'i rigs la 'di ltar ba brtsi/ glang*/ byi ba/ phag khyi/ bya/ sprel/ lug rta/ sbrul/ 'brug yos/ stag ༈ sme ba mar bzhi dang*/ chags med lugs la 'phur sme yang 'di ltar brtsi/ dgu dmar/ brgyad dkar/ bdun dmar/ drug dkar/ lnga ser/ bzhi ljang*/ 904)sum mthing*/ gnyis nag gcig dkar ro/ ༈ gshin rtsis mdor bsdus ni/ 'gram bcos bka' 'dus dag tshar/ bkra shis brtsegs pa brgya tshar/ bka' brgyad gtor bzlog tsam bya'o/ ༈ li la/ dur rgyag lug mgo/ mar khu/ g.yu btags/ phying pas dril/ rta thod chus bkang bar bya/ khams kyi phyag rgya 'di ltar/ (Figure here) bris pas dur kha chod/ khon la/ lug sha lag pa/ gser btags/ lugs lpags thu/ lug thod dang rdo ser po/ zin gyi phyag rgyas/ (Figure here) dur kha bcad/ da la) mtshar pa mar mtshon btags/ khrab bkon/ me dang ra thod/ li yi phyag rgyas (Figure here) chod/ khon la/ shing 905)thog gro phye 'od can rdzas ra lpags khyi mgo rdo dmar/

gin rgyas/ (Figure here) dur kha chod/ kham la/ sran ma/ phag sha g.yu/ gos nag phag thod tshon lnga'i dkris/ khon rgyas (Figure here) dur kha chod/ ging la) glang sha rkang g.yas nas/ ra gan/ ser pos btum/ glang mgo sa tshwa/ zon rgyas (Figure here) dur kha bcad/ zin la/ yungs dkar/ sran chung za 'og khra bo/ bskon ri bong ngam/ bong bu'i thod pa/ lcags ḍa yi phyag rgyas/ (Figure here) dur kha bcad/ zon la) yung nag zar ma/ du shu gyis btum/ mdzo rim thod pa tshwa tshwa khon rgyas/ (Figure here) dur kha chod/ (Figure here) hal khyi ni/ bya glang 906)sbrul gsum lo la shar bstod/ khyi rta stag gsum lo la byang smad/ phag lug yos gsum lo la nub bstod/ byi 'brug sprel gsum lo la lho smad/ ༈ zla ba'i hal khyi ni/ stag rta khyi gsum zla bar lho shar/ phag sogs gsum zlar nub shar/ byi sogs gsum zlar nub byang*/ bya sogs gsum ni shar nub bo/ ༈ zhag gi hal khyi ni gcig gsum shar nub/ gnyis gsum lho byang*/ gsum gsum nub shar/ bzhi gsum byang lho/ lnga gsum shar lho/ drug gsum lho nub nas/ brgyad gsum byang shar nas/ bdun gsum nub byang nas/ dgu gsum gnam nas/ bcu gsum sa nas/ ༈ dus kyi hal khyi ni/ 907)nam lang byang shar/ nyi shar byang stod/ nyi dros shar/ nyi phyed shar smad/ phyed yol shar lho/ nyi myur lho stod/ nyi thal byang lho/ mun rub lho smad/ sa srib lho nub/ srod 'khor nub bstod/ nam phyed nub smad/ phyed yol nub byang nam smad byang*/ tho rangs/ byang smad du 'khor ro/ ༈ stag yos zla bar ka bar gnas/ 'brug sbrul zla ba skas/ bya khyi zhing sa/ byi glang tha ka zam thug bcos/ gshin rje'i dbang bskur/ gshed bzlog bca' ba rtsam dgos/ ༈ bag rtsis bsdus na/ stag yos 'brug gsum lo la kha nub/ rta sbrul lug bya gsum byang*/ bya sprel khyi gsum 908)shar/ byi phag glang gsum lho rnams mi 'gro/ rta khrid bag ma'i lus kyi ma/

rta rlung rta yi ma/ srog gi grogs phyogs 'dug srog lus mar la kha blta dgos/ stan srog gi ma'o/ ༈ gza' 'og tshes kyi chu tshod ma 'ongs pa/ skar 'og 'das pa yin/ bya rta la bya yos nag glang lug la khyi 'brug nag stag sprel phag sbrul nag lam zhugs 1345 legs/ 6 ngan drug 'bring*/ 3 stag rta khyi gsum zla ba li yi tshes/ phag sogs gsum gyi zla ba zin gyis tshes/ byi 'brug sprel khams bya glang sbrul gsum 909)dwa/ stag sprel phag sbrul zla bar gcig dkar tshes/ byi rta bya yos bzhi ljang tshes/ khyi 'brug glang lug bdun dmar mar ded yin/ bkra shis/ sarba maṅga laṃ// 910) 911) nas 916) bar (tabulation forms to be done) 917) ༄༅/ rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa la brten nas mchod rten bzhengs tshul gyi 'don zin dag byed chu rgyun bzhugs so/ na mo badz+ra sa twa ye/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs che// mtshan tsam thos pas nyes ltung grib/ lhag ma med par zhi byed pa'i// bla ma rdo rje sems der btud// de yi phrin las khyad par gyis// yid can sgrib gnyis sbyong byed pa'i/ khang brtsegs mchod rten bzhengs pa'i tshul// go bde'i ngag gi lhug par bri// de la 'dir sa khang bzhengs pa dang*/ sats+tsha gdab pa'i sa len sa gnyis ka nas re re bzhin sa slong dgos pas/ bdag bskyed bla gtor/ sman raka mchod pa phreng tshar/ gzhi la mañdzi steng dkar gtor/ gser skyems/ mchod pa bskor bshams bsang chu/ cha gsum gtor ma/ chag chag rgyu dri bzang dang ba byung*/ gu gul/ yungs dkar/ seng ldeng phur pa bcu bcas 'du bya/ 918)tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ kun bzang rdor sems= khyab bdag dang po'i= badz+ra ma hā shri= sogs nas sngags 108 sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar dang*/ 'og gi bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba= sogs nas yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ mchod brlabs/ bdag bskyed spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod/ bzlas pa yig drug stong*/

yig brgya/ 100 oṃ dpal ldan rdo rje= rang gi snying ga'i= stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ mjug gi oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥslar yang rdo rje= kun la khyab/ bar/ cha gsum bka' ma ltar btang*/ sgrub khog gi oṃ ma hā kro dha= swa bhā wa= thams cad= mchod brlabs dang*/ gtor gzhong=sogs/ gtor ma brlab/ spyan drangs/ mchod pa/ gtor 'bul/ hūm̐: dgongs shig= sogs kyi gtor ma dor/ a mri tas chag chag gdab/ swa bha was/ thal mo sar 'jog rang nyid skad cig= dang*/ 919)hūm̐:yan lag sogs kyis gu gul bdug yungs dkar brab la bgegs bskrad/ 'og gi khro bcu phur gdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig bcu spros= sogs dang*/ sum bha ni= dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha= tshar bcus/ phur pa gdab/ bgegs rnams kyi snying phug hūm̐ nga ni ye nas/ dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐ bh+rum̐: bar brjod/ phur pa rnams sa len sa yin na/ nam sa blang ma tshar bar de ltar bzhag sa khang gzhir yin na/ sa la gdab nas tshur blang rgyu min/ de nas/ bla ma yi dam= dang*/ byin rlabs mchog stsol= sogs bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ de nas sats+tsha gdab mkhan rnams nas/ nang dus rdor sems bdag bskyed bsnyen pa bsdu ldang bcas gong ltar grub mtshams/ 'jim pa rin po che'i phung po gyur pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer= sogs 920)dmigs pa dang*/ sngags/ gzhung gsal kho nas gdab dgos nub mo bsngo smon bkra shis bcas bya/ sats+tsha gdab tshar dus/ sats+tsha rnams rab gnas bya ba ni/ tshig bdun/ brgyud 'debs/ bsang chu/ dkar bgegs/ yan lag bdun/ mchod brlabs/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas stong*/ yig brgya brgya/ gsol gdab/ bsdu rim/ mdun bskyed/ spyan 'dren sogs bdag bskyed ltar/ phyag mchod bstod pa/ sa twa stong*/ yig brgya brgya/ las sbyor nyer gcig bum bsnyen nyer gcig 'od zhu bcas grub nas/ sa sgrub kyi las bum sgrub/ a mṛ ta= brgya/ 'od zhu/ ye shes sku mchog= gang zhig thog med= rnal 'byor dbang=

bde bar gshegs pa= skang chen lnga/ dag gyur bcas/ dam can spyi'i gtor ma'i gtsos gsol ka rigs/ gter gzhi gnyis/ tshogs byin rlabs/ spyan 921)'dren/ spyir mchod/ mchod bshags/ skang chen/ yang bskyar/ bsgral bstab/ sbyor mchod/ sa twa āḥbar grub nas/ sa sgrub kyi gzhung gsal ltar/ gnas 'dren gyi/ zhi sbyong gsum/ sarba bigh+nan= gsum/ 'dor/ lan chags gsum/ sum bha ni= gsum/ bden stobs kha bsgyur pa sgrub ltar/ bgegs bskrad tshar nas/ lha khrus/ ji ltar rgyal ba'i= sku phyi/ de dag sku la= bcas zin nas/ sa sgrub kyi/ a mṛ ta= shu n+ya ta= stong pa'i ngang las seṅges btegs pa'i= sogs/ gzhung gsal/ spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod gong ltar/ bskyed pa'i lha= sogs dang*/ 'dir ni rten dang= su pra= ye dhar= sogs kyi me tog 'thor/ me tog dam pa= phyag byar 'os pa= phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs/ bkra shis tshang ma/ de nas tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma/ gsol ka bkyags/ chad brtan/ 922)mchod brlabs/ mchod bstod bshags gsum/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis bcas bya bas grub bo/ ༈ de bas sats+tsha du yod gzhi la bkod/ rdor sems dkyil 'khor/ dbang gzhi tshang ma gzhung ltar bshams nas sa sgrub bya ba ni/ tshig bdun/ brgyud 'debs/ bsang chu/ dkar bgegs/ yan lag bdun pa/ mchod brlabs/ bdag bskyed/ bsnyen pa sa twa/ 1000 yig brgya/ 100 gsol gdab/ 'od zhu/ mdun bskyed/ bsnyen pa sa twa/ 1000 yig brgya/ 100 las sbyor/ 21 bum bzlas/ 21 'od zhu bcas tshar nas/ sa sgrub kyi/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ badz+ra= sogs gzhung gsal/ lha bskyed/ mdun bskyed tshig lhug dang sprad/ spyan 'dren dbang bskur/ ye shes lnga mngon du gyur= rjes su/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod bstod/ rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal= sa twa= 1000 923)yig brgya la/ oṃ da ha= sogs tshan gsum/ mthar/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa=

sogs sbyar ba/ khyon 'bum ther gsum mam/ tha na 'bum ther gcig ma song thabs med yin/ thun mthar/ dpag med nam mkha'= sogs kyis mchod/ bla ma dpal ldan= sogs kyis bstod/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' kyai/ sogs kyi gsol ba gdab/ ma brnyed yongs su= yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ mchod rten lha dang= sogs/ gyur= bar/ ye shes sku mchog= sogs nas bshags pa/ yan bdun/ dam bca' rgyas bsdus/ skang chen lnga/ dag gyur bcas/ tshar dus/ 'og gi rjes chog gi mchod brlabs/ mchod bstod bshags gsum/ rten bzhugs/ rang gi snying ga'i= sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa'= sogs brjod pas snga chog grub/ phyi chog bla ma rig 924)'dzin= yan bdun/ mchod brlabs nas/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed rjes sa sgrub bcas sbyar/ ye shes sku mchog= nas bshags pa/ yan lag phyi ma/ dam bca' rgyas bsdus/ skong chen lnga dag gyur bcas zin rjes/ dam can spyi gtor gtsos gsol ka ji rigs/ gter gzhi bcas/ tshogs byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ spyir mchod mchod bshags/ skang ba yang bskyar/ bsgral bstab sbyor mchod bcas/ tshogs drang ba/ cha gsum/ bdag 'jug cha tshang*/ gdod nas lhun grub= lhag ma/ gsol ka bkyags/ chad brtan rjes chog mchod brlabs/ mchod bstod bshags gsum/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas/ nyin grangs du yin la de ltar btang dgos/ de nas sa khang bya sar sa slong gong ltar dgos/ 'og gzhir mnan pa phur pa sogs 925)dang 'brel ba/ dgra dur phung gsum mnan pa tshad ldan thon na legs kyang*/ ma grub tshe gzhung 'dis mnan pa byed na cho ga rgyas pa tshogs bskang chad brtan rjes su/ sgrub khog ltar dam sri mnan pa/ gser skyems/ e bskyed/ 'gugs pa brgya rtsa drag sngags so lnga'i thun brab/ hūm̐:gsang ba dkyil 'khor= sogs kyis/ sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum ro g.yam rgya gram gling bzhi bris pas mnan/
